title: Bank Account Fraud (BAF) Tabular Dataset Suite
summary: A publicly released suite of privacy-preserving, large-scale tabular datasets for bank account opening fraud detection, built from an anonymized real-world dataset and released with a NeurIPS 2022 paper on biased, imbalanced, dynamic tabular benchmarks. The dataset variants are produced by training a CTGANSynthesizer model directly from the standalone ctgan package to generate the synthetic fraud records.
